Match the body's kemono anime cel shading: warm amber occlusion on lower/side cheek fur, restrained golden highlights, two clean shadow tones, subtle violet/brown hair shadows and narrow cyan hair highlights, darker pink ear recesses. Preserve EXACT original geometry, all silhouettes, facial details, black linework, colors, head shape, cut hair gaps, every piece's exact pixel position, scale, atlas layout and transparent alpha. Do not add any cast shadow outside silhouettes. Keep transparent background. Same original kemono drawing style, no redesign, no realism, no 3D rendering. Output square with exactly same layout and canvas registration. This image will be mapped onto an existing rig without moving any UV or vertex.
